content.short: Arkham is an AI-powered blockchain intelligence platform that deanonymizes on-chain data and maps it to real entities.
content.description:
Arkham is a blockchain intelligence platform that uses its proprietary Ultra AI engine to deanonymize on-chain data, linking crypto addresses to real-world entities. By synthesizing on-chain and off-chain data, Arkham provides comprehensive entity profiles, transaction visualizers, and an "Intel Exchange" where users can buy and sell on-chain insights.

The platform empowers users with real-time alerts and dashboards to track fund flows and portfolio holdings. By bringing transparency to decentralized finance, Arkham serves as a critical tool for researchers and traders to understand market movements and identify key players in the Web3 ecosystem.
